title: Stop waiting for a better time
summary: The shabad refuses the mind that keeps searching the calendar for devotion. Start before the next excuse becomes your teacher.
takeaway: Start before the next excuse becomes your teacher.
lifeApplication: When 'later' rises, answer it with one breath of Naam now. Let the present moment become the place where devotion stops negotiating.
